meta.title: Predestination
sources: Spierig brothers; Heinlein All You Zombies

events.label: Baby left at orphanage
events.description: A baby girl is left at an orphanage in 1945. Nobody knows where she came from - because she was taken there from the future, by her own parent.

events.label: Jane seduced by mysterious lover
events.description: As a young woman, Jane falls for a stranger who vanishes as suddenly as he appeared. The mysterious lover turns out to be her own older self.

events.label: Jane gives birth; baby stolen
events.description: Jane gives birth after the lover walked out, and the baby is snatched from the hospital. The child will be raised in the very orphanage Jane came from - it is Jane herself.

events.label: Gender transition Jane→John
events.description: After a difficult childbirth, Jane undergoes surgery and hormones that turn her into a man. She takes the name John and has to build a new life from scratch.

events.label: John tells bartender the unbroken circle story
events.description: John, now a bartender's regular, pours out his unbelievable life story to a passing agent. The story is how he gets noticed and pulled into the agency - and the listener is his own future self.

events.label: John recruited into Temporal Agency
events.description: The agency offers John a job travelling back in time for them, since he has no family ties. He takes it, becoming the very agent who later listens to his own story.

events.label: Agent ensures Jane meets lover (self)
events.description: The agent travels back in time and makes sure Jane meets her lover - by posing as the lover himself. John, the man from the future, is the father of Jane's child.

events.label: Agent returns baby to orphanage
events.description: The agent takes the newborn from the hospital and leaves it at an orphanage in 1945. The baby grows up to be Jane, so the child raises itself.

events.label: Hunt for Fizzle Bomber across jumps
events.description: The agent spends years chasing a bomber who leaves small explosions across the past. Each visit fails to catch him, and the chase eats away at the agent.

events.label: Fizzle Bomber is aged agent self
events.description: The agent finally corners the Fizzle Bomber and pulls off the mask: it is himself, older and worn out. The man he has hunted all this time is his own future.

events.label: Agent cannot break loop; bomber continues
events.description: The agent cannot bring himself to finish the bomber off properly, so the bombings keep happening. Try as he might, he cannot break the circle his life is stuck in.

events.label: Entire biography is a closed causal unicycle
events.description: In the end every person in this story - Jane, John, the baby, the agent, the bomber - is the same individual. Their whole life was caused by themselves, with no beginning and no end.

events.label: Baby left at 1945 orphanage
events.description: A newborn is quietly left on the steps of an orphanage in 1945. That baby will grow up to be Jane, the woman whose life the whole story follows.

events.label: John meets Jane / conceives
events.description: John the time-travelling agent woos Jane as a stranger so that she will have a child. It is her own future self seducing her.

events.label: Barkeeper hears Unmarried Mother story
events.description: The bartender listens to an unmarried mother pour out an impossible life story. It is the moment the agency first hooks its recruit - and the drinker and barman are the same person years apart.

events.label: Agent burned failing bomb disarm
events.description: The agent is badly burned while trying to disarm one of the bomber's devices. The injuries and surgery leave his face changed, which is why he no longer looks like the man he was.

events.label: Agent confronts Fizzle Bomber self
events.description: The agent tracks down the bomber and confronts him face to face, realising he is looking at himself grown old. The showdown is the hinge the whole story turns on.

events.label: Bartender/agent hears unmarried mother story
events.description: A bartender hears the full strange story of the unmarried mother. The telling is deliberate: it is the recruitment interview for a man who will become an agent.

events.label: Baby stolen from hospital
events.description: A newborn vanishes from the hospital and is carried back to an orphanage decades earlier. The stolen child is the same person who suffered the theft.

events.label: Jane's life / Fizzle Bomber hunt
events.description: The story follows Jane through orphanage, romance, motherhood and her change into John, all while the hunt for the bomber rumbles on. Every step of it was arranged by John himself.

events.label: Agent, Jane, John, baby, bomber are one continuum
events.description: The twist is that Jane, John, the baby, the agent and the bomber are all one single person living in a circle. There is no family here - just one life causing itself.

events.label: Fizzle Bomber confrontations
events.description: The agent meets the Fizzle Bomber more than once and never cleanly wins. The confrontations pass the job on rather than end it.

events.label: Ontological paradox closed
events.description: The story ends where it begins, with nothing left unexplained and nothing left possible. Every event in the biography has itself as its cause.

ruleEffects.effect: Ensuring the meeting fulfills the biography
Bomber identity is self-consistent with agency career

outcome.summary: One person is mother, father, child, lover, agent, and bomber—an ontological unicycle with no external origin.
